name: Wizard Tyrant
description: Akkurdal, son of Anaki and Turul, who abused mana draining and created the Great Waste.

timeline.summary: Anaki and Turul's son Akkurdal abuses mana draining, creating the Great Waste and becoming the Wizard Tyrant; his granddaughter vows to kill him.
timeline.quote: and he is known as the Wizard Tyrant.
